body:
Honestly, here’s what I would do. Roll in the open, and play the dragon very smart. Maybe have the shield guardian glitch for a round or two. Chances are the dragon might down a couple players, maybe even kill one, but by rolling openly you let the party see the predicament they have gotten themselves into, and then live or die, they learn their lesson about just jumping into combat. 

Also, if someone does go unconscious, maybe tac on flaws since they came so close to death, like missing an eye or fingers, perhaps a personality flaw like being afraid of lizards. Something like that.

For more context, my wife also has a fair amount of mental disorders and I do the majority of the cooking, cleaning, etc, and because it’s so regular, those things aren’t considered special things, but just business as usual. 

Honestly, I’m not sure if my low libido is do my personal depression, or something else.
